name: pl.testyangielskiego/testy
title: TestyAngielskiego.pl
description: Free English tests A1-C2 for Polish learners: levels, topics, exams, sample questions. Read-only.

tools.name: list_levels
tools.description: Lists CEFR levels on TestyAngielskiego.pl with the number of tests and tasks, the matching exams and the link to each level page, plus the free placement test. Use it first when a learner does not know their level.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Lists grammar and vocabulary topics (sections) on TestyAngielskiego.pl with the number of practice sentences, levels and a link to the topic page. Optional filter by level.

level.description: CEFR level: a1, a2, b1, b2, c1, c2 (case-insensitive, e.g. "b1").

tools.name: list_exams
tools.description: Lists exams that TestyAngielskiego.pl prepares for (level, number of tests, link). Tasks are original, written in the exam format; the site is not affiliated with exam boards.

tools.name: find_tests
tools.description: Finds full online tests on TestyAngielskiego.pl by level, exam, topic, task type or a phrase in the title. Returns at most 10 tests (title, level, type, number of items, link). Tests are solved on the website, with explanations in Polish.

level.description: CEFR level: a1, a2, b1, b2, c1, c2 (case-insensitive, e.g. "b1").

exam.description: Exam id or name from list_exams.

topic.description: Grammar or vocabulary topic: id or name from list_topics (e.g. "tenses"); Polish or English name, partial match.

type.description: Task type id from the result field `types` (e.g. "g" = sentences with a gap).

tools.name: practice_questions
tools.description: Returns up to 5 random multiple-choice practice sentences from a small sample set of TestyAngielskiego.pl, filtered by level and/or topic, each with the correct answer, a short explanation in Polish and a link to the full test on the website. Not the whole bank: for more, send the learner to the test link.

level.description: CEFR level: a1, a2, b1, b2, c1, c2 (case-insensitive, e.g. "b1").

topic.description: Grammar or vocabulary topic: id or name from list_topics (e.g. "tenses"); Polish or English name, partial match.
